**Build's clean now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js) used `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js) treated an unset flag as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` rather than `false`.

The rest was deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), harmless.

Next: nothing, build passes with only expected deprecation warnings left.
